name: MSG_USE
meaning: from Sheep: eatTime += g_dt, eaten at 3 s

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: Wolf/Robot -> 4 (pickup) in state 0; Sheep -> 0x25 (0 while liftBlocked)

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach; arg {Vec3s pos; u16 flags(bit1 keep pos)}

name: MSG_QUERY_NEAREST_TARGET
meaning: held-item query from Wolf_ScanContextActions: arg {u16 classId, u16 dist*0xffff/600}

name: MSG_CONTAINER_STATE
meaning: arg 1 (released from a container): homePos = pos. Not a checkpoint message (senders: Mailbox, box, FloatingBox)

name: MSG_GEYSER_OUT
meaning: squash unless state 1/3, copy sender rot (sender 0x4c5f25)
